description: This Java class defines a custom file filter used in a Swing-based GUI application to identify files with specific extensions ('bin' and 'hex') as ECU image files.

classes.name: ECUImageFilter
classes.description: A Java class that extends FileFilter to filter ECU image files with specific extensions ('bin' and 'hex') for use in file chooser dialogs.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether the specified file is accepted by this filter based on its extension.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a description string for this filter, indicating it filters ECU image files.
